newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline eases lower, waits for U.S. direction.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline eases lower, waits for U.S. direction.

text.p: NWE gasoline was $1-2 a tonne weaker on Monday as the market awaited direction from the U.S.
Premium unleaded barges were pegged at $187 fob with swaps also easing down. July was talked down to $185 from $186.50 while August and September also slipped to $184 and $182.50 respectively.
Dealers said liquidity was slender with most players opting for a waiting game to see which way NYMEX gasoline will swing.
